about: The boat kit's round-2 options (catalogue §4 B1-B11 and S4b's asks) proposed for every mapped boat that the needs lists, S2's gen/sections/canal/boats/b_options.json and S4b's run-2 report say needs them: merge each `add` into the boat's build_choices.json `boats.<id>.kit` (the area decides; positions along the hull are fractions of the waterline from the stern, 0, to the stem, 1, as the cabin dicts'). Built and checked headless by the kit factory on every area's layout (`kit_factory` test: gen/boats/round2_test.json). Option reference: blender/kit_boats.py boat_nodes() doc and gen/boats/types.md.
